suggestions: I'm grateful for a deploy that went out clean on a Friday and didn't ruin my weekend.
I'm thankful for the mamak still being open when I need teh tarik at 1am to think straight.
I'm grateful for finally figuring out why that bug only happened in production, not in any test.
I'm thankful for the few minutes of stillness right before Fajr, before the phone starts buzzing.
I'm grateful for a code review comment that actually taught me something instead of just nitpicking.
I'm thankful for rain hitting the roof hard enough to drown out everything else for a bit.
I'm grateful for a staff meeting that ended early for once.
I'm thankful for my mother still calling just to ask if I've eaten.
I'm grateful for a salary that clears on time, every time, no drama.
I'm thankful for an old kawan texting out of nowhere just to check in.
I'm grateful for a terminal that finally stopped throwing that dependency error after hours of nonsense.
I'm thankful for the first sip of air kosong after a long day of fasting.
I'm grateful for a manager who actually reads the Slack message before replying.
I'm thankful for traffic that, against all odds, moved on the highway home today.
I'm grateful for a weekend with nothing on the calendar and nowhere I have to be.
